Yes, we should all thank @elonmusk for buying Twitter.

He saved freedom speech.


Muskonomy (@muskonomy)

NEWS: Travis Kalanick (@travisk) says, we should all thank @elonmusk for buying Twitter.

The Uber founder, back in public after years out of the spotlight, credited new media and Elon Musk for why he is speaking again.

In a recent interview he said: "Elon buying Twitter is the beginning of us being able to speak our minds and for disagreeing to not be illegal. That's a big deal. We should all thank Elon for that."

Kalanick said old media was overwhelmingly negative and that podcasts now let people "say what you need to say" without going through legacy outlets.
